title: Gallstone Impacted in Neck of Gallbladder on CT
author: James Heilman, MD
caption: Axial abdominal CT demonstrating a calcified gallstone impacted in the gallbladder neck.
alt_text: Axial CT scan showing a hyperdense gallstone lodged in the neck of the gallbladder.
clinical_relevance: Demonstrates cystic duct neck obstruction that precipitates acute cholecystitis (CLIFF-029, p.1, p.8).
